description: This PHP source file defines the LoggerLevel class, which encapsulates log level constants and methods for a PHP logging framework based on log4j. It includes level definitions such as OFF, FATAL, ERROR, WARN, INFO, DEBUG, and ALL, along with methods to retrieve level instances, compare levels, and convert string or integer inputs to level objects.

classes.name: LoggerLevel
classes.description: Represents a logging level with associated properties such as level value, string label, and syslog equivalent. Provides methods to compare levels, convert string/integer inputs to levels, and retrieve predefined level instances.

methods.name: LoggerLevel
methods.description: Constructor that initializes a logger level with level value, string label, and syslog equivalent.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks if another LoggerLevel object has the same level value.

methods.name: getLevelOff
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance representing the OFF level.

methods.name: getLevelFatal
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance representing the FATAL level.

methods.name: getLevelError
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance representing the ERROR level.

methods.name: getLevelWarn
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance representing the WARN level.

methods.name: getLevelInfo
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance representing the INFO level.

methods.name: getLevelDebug
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance representing the DEBUG level.

methods.name: getLevelAll
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance representing the ALL level.

methods.name: getSyslogEquivalent
methods.description: Returns the syslog equivalent integer of this log level.

methods.name: isGreaterOrEqual
methods.description: Determines if this level is greater than or equal to another LoggerLevel.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns the string label of this log level.

methods.name: toInt
methods.description: Returns the integer value of this log level.

methods.name: toLevel
methods.description: Converts a string or integer argument to a corresponding LoggerLevel instance, defaulting to DEBUG if conversion fails.
